instructions.question: Does any word in the clue contain the letters of the answer in sequence, as a prefix, suffix, or part of a compound word?
instructions.focus: Compare literal letters, not meaning. A clue that merely DEFINES the answer is not a leak; only a clue that spells the answer out inside one of its own words is a leak.

true.what: A clue word contains the answer's letters in sequence, so the solver can read the answer off the clue.
examples: answer SCREW, clue "Fastener you turn with a screwdriver" (screwdriver starts with SCREW)
answer WED, clue "Have a wedding" (wedding starts with WED)
answer MELON, clue "Watermelon or cantaloupe" (watermelon ends with MELON)
answer ALPHA, clue "First letter in the Greek alphabet" (alphabet starts with ALPHA)
answer BED, clue "Piece of bedroom furniture" (bedroom starts with BED)
answer DINO, clue "Fred Flintstone's dinosaur pet" (dinosaur starts with DINO)

false.what: No clue word contains the answer's letters in sequence.
examples: answer SOAR, clue "Rise high, as an eagle" (no clue word contains SOAR)
answer WENT, clue "Past tense of go" (naming another form of the word is not a leak)
answer THRU, clue "Casual way to spell through" (through does not contain T-H-R-U in sequence)
answer CIA, clue "U.S. spy agency, briefly" (agency does not contain C-I-A in sequence)
